tools.name: algolia_list_indices
tools.description: List the indices in the Algolia application with their entry counts, sizes and update times. Good first call. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes.

tools.name: algolia_search_index
tools.description: Search one index and return the matching records (hits) with highlights and facets when requested. Up to 1,000 hits; use paging for more. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/query.

tools.name: algolia_multi_search
tools.description: Run one or more search queries across one or more indices in one call and return one result per query, in order. A hit query has indexName and query. A facet query has indexName, type "facet", facet and query. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/*/queries.

tools.name: algolia_search_facet_values
tools.description: Search the values of one facet in an index, for example brand names that start with "App". Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/facets/{facetName}/query.

tools.name: algolia_get_object
tools.description: Get one record by objectID, optionally with only some attributes. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_get_objects
tools.description: Get up to 1,000 records by objectID across indices in one call. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/*/objects.

tools.name: algolia_get_settings
tools.description: Get an index's settings: searchable and facet attributes, ranking, typo tolerance and more. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/settings.

tools.name: algolia_search_synonyms
tools.description: Search the synonyms of an index. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/synonyms/search.

tools.name: algolia_get_synonym
tools.description: Get one synonym by objectID. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/synonyms/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_search_rules
tools.description: Search the query rules of an index (rules that change results for matching queries or contexts). Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/rules/search.

tools.name: algolia_get_rule
tools.description: Get one query rule by objectID. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/rules/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_get_task
tools.description: Check whether an index write (returned as taskID) is published yet. Algolia API: GET /1/indexes/{indexName}/task/{taskID}.

tools.name: algolia_get_logs
tools.description: Get the last seven days of API log entries (queries, indexing, errors), newest first. Needs a key with the logs permission. Algolia API: GET /1/logs.

tools.name: algolia_save_object
tools.description: Add a new record with an auto-generated objectID. Changes the index. Returns the new objectID and a taskID. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}.

tools.name: algolia_add_or_replace_object
tools.description: Add a record with this objectID, or replace the whole existing record. Replacing drops attributes not sent. Changes the index. Algolia API: PUT /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

tools.name: algolia_partial_update_object
tools.description: Change only the given attributes of one record and keep the rest. Changes the index. Algolia API: POST /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}/partial.

tools.name: algolia_delete_object
tools.description: Delete one record by objectID. The record is removed from search results after the returned taskID completes. Algolia API: DELETE /1/indexes/{indexName}/{objectID}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "algolia_search_rules" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: indexName, query, anchoring, context, enabled, page, hitsPerPage

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: algolia_search_index, algolia_multi_search, algolia_search_facet_values, algolia_get_objects, algolia_search_synonyms, algolia_search_rules · Private data: algolia_search_index, algolia_get_object, algolia_get_objects, algolia_save_object, algolia_add_or_replace_object, algolia_partial_update_object, algolia_delete_object · Public sink: algolia_search_index, algolia_multi_search, algolia_search_facet_values, algolia_get_objects, algolia_search_synonyms, algolia_search_rules, algolia_save_object, algolia_partial_update_object · Destructive: algolia_multi_search, algolia_delete_object.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: algolia_search_index, algolia_multi_search, algolia_search_facet_values, algolia_get_objects, algolia_search_synonyms, algolia_search_rules · Private data: algolia_search_index, algolia_get_object, algolia_get_objects, algolia_save_object, algolia_add_or_replace_object, algolia_partial_update_object, algolia_delete_object · Public sink: algolia_search_index, algolia_multi_search, algolia_search_facet_values, algolia_get_objects, algolia_search_synonyms, algolia_search_rules, algolia_save_object, algolia_partial_update_object · Destructive: algolia_multi_search, algolia_delete_object

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
